disclaimerBody.general: Content on this website is provided for general information and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis or treatment for any individual.
disclaimerBody.noRelationship: Reading this website or submitting an inquiry does not create a doctor–patient relationship. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional about your individual situation.
disclaimerBody.outcomes: Fertility treatment outcomes vary between individuals. Nothing on this website should be read as a guarantee of pregnancy or of any treatment result.
disclaimerBody.emergency: If you have an urgent medical concern, please contact your nearest hospital or emergency service. Do not use this website's inquiry form for emergencies.

cookieBody.used: This development version of the website uses only cookies that are strictly necessary for it to function (for example, remembering your language). It does not use analytics or advertising cookies. This section will be updated if that changes.
